name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is implemented by the National Health Authority under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. It aims to provide cashless hospitalisation coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare services to poor and vulnerable families. The supplied myScheme source describes rural eligibility through deprivation and automatic-inclusion criteria and urban eligibility through specified occupational categories.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_groups: rural households meeting specified deprivation criteria
urban workers in specified occupational categories
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
Coverage is available for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
Treatment costs can include consultation, medicines, diagnostics, surgery, ICU, implants, accommodation and food.
Provides coverage for 3 days of pre-hospitalisation expenses and 15 days of post-hospitalisation expenses.
Complications arising during treatment are covered.
Pre-existing diseases are covered from day one.
There is no restriction on age, gender or family size.
Benefits are portable across India at empanelled hospitals.
The supplied myScheme information states coverage of approximately 1,929 medical procedures.

rules.description: Applicant must meet the PM-JAY entitlement criteria applicable to the household or occupational category. The supplied myScheme source describes rural eligibility through specified deprivation or automatic-inclusion criteria and urban eligibility through specified occupational categories.

exclusion_rules.description: Those who own a two, three, or four-wheeler or a motorized fishing boat are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those who own mechanized farming equipment are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those who have a Kisan card with a credit limit of ₹50,000 or more are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those employed by the government are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those who work in government-managed non-agricultural enterprises are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those earning a monthly income above ₹10,000 are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those owning refrigerators and landlines are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those owning a decent, solidly built house are excluded according to the supplied source.
Those owning 5 acres or more of agricultural land are excluded according to the supplied source.

documents.description: The supplied source lists Aadhaar Card or PAN Card as age and identity proof.
Proof of address is listed among the required documents.
Mobile and email contact details are listed among the required information.

Income certificate is listed among the required documents.

tutorial_steps.title: Visit a hospital or Community Service Centre
tutorial_steps.description: A potential beneficiary can visit a hospital or CSC to begin identification for a PM-JAY e-card.

tutorial_steps.title: Submit beneficiary identification details
tutorial_steps.description: Provide available details such as the PM letter, RSBY URN, ration card number or mobile number to the Arogya Mitra.

tutorial_steps.title: Search the beneficiary database
tutorial_steps.description: The Arogya Mitra searches the available entitled databases, including the relevant SECC, RSBY, State Health Scheme or Additional Data Collection Drive databases.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete individual identification
tutorial_steps.description: If the beneficiary is found in the entitled list, Aadhaar or another government ID and a ration card or alternative family ID are used to validate the identity. Scanned documents are uploaded.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete family identification
tutorial_steps.description: The Arogya Mitra identifies the family records using the ration card and supporting scanned documents.

tutorial_steps.title: Submit records for approval
tutorial_steps.description: The individual and family records are submitted to the trust or insurance company for approval.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete approval process
tutorial_steps.description: The health insurance company or trust may approve or recommend rejection. Cases recommended for rejection are finally verified by the State Health Agency.

tutorial_steps.title: Receive PM-JAY e-card
tutorial_steps.description: After approval by the State Health Agency, insurance company or trust, an e-card is issued to the beneficiary.
